indicator.name: Equity Risk Premium (proxy)
indicator.description: An earnings-yield-based proxy for the compensation offered by equities over Treasuries.
indicator.methodology: Preferred method: forward earnings yield (1 / forward P/E) minus the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield. When no licensed forward P/E is available, the dashboard uses a clearly labeled trailing proxy: Shiller nominal trailing earnings divided by the S&P 500 price, minus the 10-year Treasury yield. Both legs are nominal.
indicator.limitations: The fallback is an earnings-yield proxy, not a full expected-return model. It ignores growth, payout policy, buybacks, and risk premia embedded in forward estimates. The preferred forward-based version requires licensed forward earnings.
